role: ViewModifier that asks the system for an App Store rating on appear when ReviewPromptPolicy allows it; applied to the dashboard's top sentinel.
types: ReviewPromptOnAppear: struct (ViewModifier) — inputs isActive, baselineNights, hasScore; environment requestReview (StoreKit)
state: ud:reviewPrompt.lastRequestedVersion, ud:reviewPrompt.lastRequestedDate (read and written by requestIfEligible)
toplevel: Applied in DashboardV2View.dashboardTopSentinel with the dashboard's isActive, baselineNights and displayedScore != nil.

units.does: Returns the content with an onAppear that calls requestIfEligible.

Reads the app version and the stored last-asked version/date; if isActive, this is not a UI-test run and ReviewPromptPolicy.shouldRequest allows it, after 2 s stores the version and date and calls the system requestReview action (the system may show nothing).

branches.cond: not isActive OR UI-test run OR shouldRequest false

branches.effect: after 2 s: stores version and date, calls requestReview()
